text: In June 2017, we converged. On June 8, ninety-six of us said "the financial choice"; ninety-five said "financial choice act"; ninety-four said "the financial choice act." STATS records the first to say it, on June 8, 2016, as Debbie Wasserman Schultz. Later, seventy-nine of us reached "no sanctuary for criminals act," peaking June 29, first entered June 23. On June 13, seventy-five of us said "of veterans affairs"; seventy-one, "accountability and whistleblower"; seventy, "and whistleblower protection act" — that last first said, per STATS, by Tammy Baldwin. These were our most-repeated phrases of the era. We note that the two we said most were, by this record, first spoken before June 2017, and first entered by members STATS names but does not count among us. We report the count; we do not narrate the reason.
